senses.gloss: घट- + कर्पर घट- + कर्पर, m. a broken jar, Ghaṭak. 22.

घट् घट् (akin partly to हन्, partly to घट्ट्).
 --i. 1, Ātm. (also Par., MBh. 3, 14703),
 1. To endeavour, MBh. 3, 1581.
 2. To work, MBh. 5, 256.
 3. To take place, Śiś. 9, 44.
 4. To be possible, Bhāg. P. 7, 10, 3.
 5. To fall into, Lass. 18, 8 (one's hand).
 6. To be joined, Mālat. p. 38, 9.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. अ-घटित, adj. impossible, Bhāg. P. 6, 16, 44.
 --Caus.
 I. घटय,
 1. To join, Pañc. 40, 12.
 2. To put on, Gīt. 12, 26.
 3. To fetch, Bhartṛ. 3, 18.
 4. To make, Pañc. 44, 16; to perform, Rājat. 4, 364.
 5. To endeavour, MBh. 3, 14702.
 6. To touch, MBh. 4, 637.
 II., also i. 10, Par. घाटय,
 1. (cf. उद्, परि), To injure.
 2. † To shine or speak.
 --With the prep. व्या वि-आ, व्याघटित, Returned (?), Lass. 22, 9.
 --With उद् उद्, Caus. घाटय,
 1. To open, Mṛcch. 80, 7.
 2. To discover (as a secret), Pañc. 184, 16.
 3. To begin, Hit. iv. d. 2.
 4. To tickle, Suśr. 2, 370, 2.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 1. उद्घाटित, Rājat. 2, 100.
 2. उद्घटित, Kūmar. 7, 53.
 --With परि परि, Caus. घाटय, To strike, to sound, Mṛcch. 11, 4 (v. r.).
 --With वि वि,
 1. To burst, to crumble down, Prab. 8, 11.
 2. To become interrupted, Hit. iv. d. 2.
 --Caus. घटय,
 1. To tear, Prab. 116, 3.
 2. To ruin, Hit. ii. d. 157.
 --With सम् सम्, To assemble, Rājat. 6, 242.
 --Caus. घटय,
 1. To strike, to sound, Rām. 2, 71, 26.
 2. To collect, Rājat. 5, 326.

घट्ट् घट्ट् (probably a denominative derived from a dialectical form of घृष्ट, vb. घृष्, based on the original घर्ष्ट), i. 1, Ātm. and i. 10 Par., घट्टय,
 1. To slip over, to touch, Suśr. 2, 28, 4.
 2. To stir, MBh. 7, 7742.
 3. To shake, MBh. 7, 9401.
 4. To churn, Suśr. 2, 88, 19.
 --With अव अव, घट्टय,
 1. To push away, Rām. 5, 15, 10.
 2. To touch, MBh. 11, 462.
 3. To besmear, Suśr. 1, 42, 17.
 4. To churn, Suśr. 1, 33, 4. अवघट्टित, n. Butting at each other, Hariv. 4720.
 --With परि परि, घट्टय, To rub, Śiś. 9, 64.
 --With वि वि, घट्टय, To open, MBh. 2, 1674. विघट्टित,
 1. Dispersed, Bhartṛ. 3, 36.
 2. Churned, Suśr. 1, 32, 19.
 3. Shaken, Kumāras. 1, 9.
 4. Hurt, Suśr. 1, 71, 18.
 5. Severed, Ṛt. 3, 8.
 6. Disclosed, MBh. 4, 1494.
 --With सम् सम्, घट्ट्, To grind, Rām. 6, 68, 30. घट्टय,
 1. To rub, Ragh. 6, 73.
 2. To stir, MBh. 7, 8584.
 3. To collect, MBh. 7, 3512.

घट घट् + अ, m.
 I. adj. Active, Pañc. ii. d. 74.
 II. m.
 1. A jar, Man. 11, 183 (184).
 2. The Aquarius of the zodiac, Mārk. P. 12, 22 (change घटी to घटः).
 III. f. टा,
 1. A multitude, Bhāg. P. 3, 17, 6.
 2. A troop of elephants assembled for martial purposes, [] Rājat. 1, 369.
 IV. f. टी, A jar, Prab. 22, 18.
 --Comp.
घटक घट् + अक, adj. Striving, Bhartṛ. 2, 66.

घटन घट् + अन, n. and f. ना,
 1. Striving, Pañc. i. d. 175.
 2. Exertion, Śāntiś. 2, 20.
 3. Junction, Vikr. d. 34, v. r.; Kathās. 24, 231.
 4. Composition, Lass. 68, 12.

घट्टन घट्ट् + अन, n.
 1. Scratching, Rām. 6, 98, 25.
 2. Touching, Hariv. 14581.
 3. Churning, Mārk. P. 12, 38.

घटिका घटिका, i. e. घटी + क, f.
 1. A jar, Pañc. i. d. 206; a bucket, Mṛcch. 178, 7.
 2. A मुहूर्त, or thirtieth part of a day and night, Bhāg. P. 5, 21, 4.
घाटिका घाटिका, Pañc. 209, 24; 211, 24; 212, 4 = घटिका, which is probably to be read.
घट्टितृ घट्ट्-इतृ, m. One who strives, MBh. 3, 5890.
घटिका- + यन्त्र घटिका- + यन्त्र (thus to be corrected, Pañc. 212, 4), and घटी-, n. the rope and bucket of a well, Mārk. P. 12, 20.
